mechanisms.reading: A two-month printed term coexists with a sale notice worded around ninety days before its end and template references to an option. Sale is subject to preserving tenant rights; no independent option grant is established in these printed clauses.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Silently repair the ninety-day wording, treat sale as automatic termination, or infer an option from incidental references.
mechanisms.correction: Flag the timing ambiguity and keep sale notice, sale effect and an unestablished option separate.
unresolved: whether a sale and notice occurred
intended meaning of the ninety-day formula

mechanisms.reading: Two monthly rent transfers are directed to different recipients. Separately, security said to be already held is returnable within thirty days after the term subject to proof of no debt; its type, number and amount are not listed here.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Double the monthly rent, count the transfers as security, or import named cheques from another TF_B edition.
mechanisms.correction: Keep one monthly obligation, two payment instances and an unidentified security bundle. A return term does not prove issuance or inventory.

mechanisms.reading: Early departure generally leaves rent through the term, with a special route for an acceptable replacement taking the contract terms. The landlord undertakes not to reject unreasonably; a general transfer restriction appears separately.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Erase the replacement route with the general ban or treat mere nomination as automatic release.
mechanisms.correction: Read both clauses; distinguish nomination, acceptance, transfer and payment release.

mechanisms.reading: Registration is due ten days from taking possession, receipts ten days after demand, and correction of protocol defects ten days after a protocol planned twenty-one days before return.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Collapse three ten-day periods into one notice or count them all from signing.
mechanisms.correction: Attach each duration to its own action and trigger; do not assert an inspection or demand occurred.

mechanisms.reading: The condition acknowledgment has a hidden-defect qualification and separate landlord repair duties. Clause 8.2 lets the landlord repair a tenant-side defect and seek costs; a broad no-setoff term appears elsewhere.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Treat AS IS as deleting repair duties or invert clause 8.2 into tenant repair reimbursement and rent setoff.
mechanisms.correction: Keep the repair obligor, reimbursement direction, defect type and no-setoff wording separate without deciding legal validity.

mechanisms.reading: One double-daily-rent holdover amount has multiple descriptions; other payments may continue. Seven days after written rent demand, ninety days for a different named event, and three working days of presumed registered-mail delivery have distinct purposes.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Count two daily charges from one clause, apply one cure period to every breach, or equate presumed delivery with cure or physical eviction.
mechanisms.correction: Track the monetary head, triggering breach, demand, delivery, cure and return independently; do not claim an enforcement outcome.
